items.title: Ethereum’s next upgrade breaks the '21,000 gas' rule wallets rely on
items.summary: Sending ETH to a brand-new address will cost more than sending to an existing one, and software built around a flat fee will get the sum wrong.

items.title: Ethereum Foundation warns some tools may break with Glamsterdam upgrade
items.summary: Developers have been urged to test on Plataberget before Glamsterdam’s new gas model reaches Ethereum’s other testnets and mainnet.

items.title: Ethereum Developers Target Privacy Changes in Next Major Upgrade
items.summary: A proposed package would let privacy pools pay their own transaction fees without relying on intermediaries.
